expectations.method: Manually authored source-anchored editorial expectations; not generated from graph adjacency or acceptance-baseline equality. This is a deliberately small checklist, not an exhaustive gold standard. Reviewer must adjudicate missing/mismatched anchors. Checklist independently challenged against source by a separate reviewing agent; includes known current omissions, not only implemented edges.
